source.text: הָעָם֙ הַהֹלְכִ֣ים בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ רָא֖וּ א֣וֹר גָּד֑וֹל יֹשְׁבֵי֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ צַלְמָ֔וֶת א֖וֹר נָגַ֥הּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: The people the walking in darkness have seen light great; dwellers in [a] land of death-shadow, light has shone on them.

en.L: The people who walk in darkness have seen a great light; \q those who dwell in a land of death's shadow, a light has shone on them.
en.B: The people walking in the dark have seen a great light. \q Those who lived in a land as dark as death now have light shining on them.
en.R: The people who were living in the dark have seen a bright light. \q They lived in a land as dark as death, but now a light shines on them.

es.L: El pueblo que anda en tinieblas ha visto una gran luz; \q los que habitan en tierra de sombra de muerte, una luz ha resplandecido sobre ellos.
es.B: El pueblo que caminaba en la oscuridad ha visto una gran luz. \q Sobre los que vivían en una tierra tan oscura como la muerte ahora brilla la luz.
es.R: El pueblo que vivía en la oscuridad ha visto una luz brillante. \q Vivían en una tierra tan oscura como la muerte, pero ahora una luz brilla sobre ellos.

fr.L: Le peuple qui marche dans les ténèbres a vu une grande lumière ; \q ceux qui habitent au pays de l’ombre de la mort, une lumière a brillé sur eux.
fr.B: Le peuple qui marchait dans l’obscurité a vu une grande lumière. \q Sur ceux qui habitaient un pays sombre comme la mort, la lumière brille maintenant.
fr.R: Le peuple qui vivait dans l’obscurité a vu une lumière éclatante. \q Ils vivaient dans un pays aussi sombre que la mort, mais maintenant une lumière brille sur eux.

sw.L: Watu wanaotembea gizani wameona nuru kubwa; \q wakaao katika nchi ya kivuli cha mauti, nuru imewachomozea.
sw.B: Watu wanaotembea gizani wameona nuru kubwa. \q Wale walioishi katika nchi yenye giza kama la kifo sasa nuru inawaangazia.
sw.R: Watu waliokuwa wakiishi gizani wameona nuru angavu. \q Waliishi katika nchi yenye giza kama kifo, lakini sasa nuru inawaangazia.

vi.L: Dân đi trong tối tăm đã thấy ánh sáng lớn; \q những người ở trong xứ bóng của sự chết, ánh sáng đã chiếu trên họ.
vi.B: Dân đang bước đi trong bóng tối đã thấy một ánh sáng lớn. \q Những người sống trong xứ tối tăm như sự chết, nay có ánh sáng chiếu rọi trên họ.
vi.R: Dân đang sống trong bóng tối đã thấy một ánh sáng rực rỡ. \q Họ sống trong một xứ tối tăm như sự chết, nhưng nay ánh sáng chiếu trên họ.

ko.L: 어둠 속에서 걷는 백성이 큰 빛을 보았다. \q 죽음의 그늘이 드리운 땅에 사는 자들, 그들 위에 빛이 비쳤다.
ko.B: 어둠 속을 걷던 백성이 큰 빛을 보았다. \q 죽음같이 어두운 땅에 살던 사람들에게 빛이 비친다.
ko.R: 어둠 속에서 살던 백성이 밝은 빛을 보았다. \q 그들은 죽음처럼 어두운 땅에 살았지만, 이제 빛이 그들을 비춘다.

pt.L: O povo que anda em trevas viu uma grande luz; \q os que habitam numa terra de sombra da morte, uma luz brilhou sobre eles.
pt.B: O povo que caminha na escuridão viu uma grande luz. \q Sobre os que viviam numa terra escura como a morte, agora brilha a luz.
pt.R: O povo que vivia no escuro viu uma luz forte. \q Eles moravam numa terra escura como a morte, mas agora uma luz brilha sobre eles.

am.L: በጨለማ የሚሄድ ሕዝብ ታላቅ ብርሃን አየ፤ \q በሞት ጥላ ምድር ለሚኖሩት ብርሃን ፈነጠቀላቸው።
am.B: በጨለማ የሚሄድ ሕዝብ ታላቅ ብርሃን አየ። \q የሞት ጥላ ባጠላበት ምድር ለሚኖሩት አሁን ብርሃን በራላቸው።
am.R: በጨለማ ይኖሩ የነበሩ ሰዎች ደማቅ ብርሃን አይተዋል። \q እንደ ሞት በጨለመ ምድር ይኖሩ ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ብርሃን ያበራላቸዋል።

hi.L: जो लोग अंधकार में चलते हैं, उन्होंने बड़ी ज्योति देखी है; \q जो मृत्यु की छाया के देश में रहते हैं, उन पर ज्योति चमकी है।
hi.B: अंधकार में चलनेवाले लोगों ने बड़ी ज्योति देखी है। \q जो मृत्यु जैसे अंधेरे देश में रहते थे, उन पर अब ज्योति चमक रही है।
hi.R: जो लोग अँधेरे में रहते थे, उन्होंने एक बड़ी रोशनी देखी है। \q वे ऐसे देश में रहते थे जो मौत की तरह अँधेरा था, पर अब उन पर रोशनी चमक रही है।

ru.L: Народ, ходящий во тьме, увидел великий свет; \q живущие в земле смертной тени — свет воссиял над ними.
ru.B: Народ, живущий во тьме, увидел великий свет. \q Над теми, кто жил в краю, тёмном, как смерть, теперь сияет свет.
ru.R: Люди, жившие во тьме, увидели великий свет. \q Они жили в краю, тёмном, как смерть, но теперь над ними сияет свет.

ja.L: 暗闇を歩いている民が、大きな光を見た。 \q 死の陰の地に住む者たち、彼らの上に光が差した。
ja.B: 暗闇の中を歩いていた民が、大きな光を見た。 \q 死のように暗い地に住んでいた者たちの上に、今、光が照り輝いている。
ja.R: 暗い所で暮らしていた人々が、明るい光を見た。 \q 彼らは死のように暗い土地に住んでいたが、今、その上に光が輝いている。

uk.L: Народ, що ходить у темряві, побачив велике світло; \q ті, що живуть у краю смертної тіні, — світло засяяло над ними.
uk.B: Народ, що ходить у темряві, побачив велике світло. \q Над тими, хто жив у краю, темному, як смерть, тепер сяє світло.
uk.R: Люди, які жили в темряві, побачили яскраве світло. \q Вони жили в краю, темному, як смерть, але тепер над ними сяє світло.

decisions.choice: Hebrew verse numbers: this is 9:1 in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew text chapter 8 has twenty-three verses, and the verse about Zebulun and Naphtali and "Galilee of the nations" is 8:23. Bibles that follow the older Latin and Greek division call that verse 9:1, so 9:1-20 here are 9:2-21 there. Isaiah is cited by the Hebrew numbers throughout.

decisions.choice: death's shadow: the deepest darkness, darkness like death
decisions.reason: The word is written as if made of "shadow" and "death" (tsalmavet), and is used of the darkest places: the realm of the dead (Job 38:17), a dark valley (Psalm 23:4), a dungeon (Psalm 107:10). Whether or not it was first formed that way, it means a darkness as deep as death.

decisions.choice: have seen, has shone: the coming light is described as already here
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the form for completed action, following the promise of 8:23 that God will bring honor to Galilee in the time to come. A prophet can describe what God will surely do as already done. Matthew 4:15-16 quotes 8:23-9:1 of Jesus beginning his work in Galilee.

decisions.choice: a land as dark as death
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the compound (m2); Literal keeps the picture of death's shadow.

decisions.choice: sombra de muerte (L); tan oscura como la muerte (B, R)
decisions.reason: L keeps the picture of tsalmavet, death's shadow, with the key words of Matthew 4:16; B and R give its sense, as the English does. This is Hebrew 9:1, 9:2 in many Bibles.

decisions.choice: "kivuli cha mauti" (L), "giza kama la kifo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, close to the Swahili of Matthew 4:16, which quotes this verse; Balanced and Readable give the sense, as the English does (m2).

decisions.choice: "Le peuple ... a vu une grande lumière"
decisions.reason: Matthew 4:16 quotes the verse; the French keeps the key words of the published Matthew 4:16 ("le peuple", "a vu une grande lumière"). This is 9:2 in many Bibles (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "bóng của sự chết" (L); "tối tăm như sự chết" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the image that Matthew 4:16 also uses ("bóng sự chết"); Balanced and Readable give its sense, deepest darkness, as the meaning decision does. The verse is 9:1 in the Hebrew numbering (9:2 in many Bibles).

decisions.choice: "어둠", "큰 빛", "죽음의 그늘" (L)
alternatives: | The key terms of Matthew 4:16, which quotes this verse, without copying its sentence. Verse numbers follow the Hebrew (this is 9:2 in Bibles with the later numbering; meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: anda (L), caminha (B); sombra da morte (L); escura como a morte (B, R)
decisions.reason: Matthew 4:16 quotes this verse from the Greek, which says the people "sat" in darkness ("estava sentado" at Literal, "habitava" at Balanced in Matthew's Portuguese). The Hebrew says they "walk", so Isaiah keeps "anda" and "caminha"; the rest keeps Matthew's words where the Hebrew has the same: "viu uma grande luz", and at Literal "sombra da morte" (m2). The verse is 9:2 in Bibles that follow the later numbering; the files follow the Hebrew (8:23 is Matthew 4:15).

decisions.choice: "have seen a great light ... light has shone on them": "ታላቅ ብርሃን አየ", "ብርሃን ፈነጠቀላቸው" (L), "የሞት ጥላ ባጠላበት ምድር" (B), as Matthew 4:16
decisions.reason: Matthew 4:16 quotes the verse from the Greek, which has "sat" where the Hebrew has "walk"; the Amharic keeps Matthew's words where the two agree and follows the Hebrew in "የሚሄድ". The verse numbers follow the Hebrew text, in which this is 9:1 (9:2 in most English Bibles).

decisions.choice: बड़ी ज्योति देखी; उन पर ज्योति चमकी (L, B); एक बड़ी रोशनी देखी है (R)
decisions.reason: Matthew 4:16 quotes this verse; where the Hebrew says the same, the words match the Hindi of Matthew at each level (ज्योति at L and B, रोशनी at R). Matthew follows the Greek "sitting in darkness" and "the region and shadow of death"; the Hebrew has "walking" and "a land of death's shadow", so those words follow the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: मृत्यु की छाया
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of death's shadow; Balanced and Readable say "a land as dark as death", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "увидел великий свет" (L, B), "увидели великий свет" (R), as Matthew 4:16 at each level
decisions.reason: Matthew 4:16 quotes this line and the Hebrew says the same here, so the Russian keeps the Gospel's words; Readable keeps "великий" with Matthew rather than following the English "bright". Where Matthew has "sitting" (the Greek Old Testament) the Hebrew has "walking", and the Russian follows the Hebrew: "ходящий" (L).

decisions.choice: "в краю, тёмном, как смерть"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the compound "death's shadow" (m2), as the English does; Literal keeps "смертной тени".

decisions.choice: tsalmavet "死の陰" (L, as Matthew 4:16 B "死の陰の地"), "死のように暗い" (B, R, as the English "as dark as death"). The verse is drafted from the Hebrew; Matthew 4:15-16 quotes it from the Greek, and the two agree in their images (暗闇, 大きな光, 死の陰) though not word for word.
decisions.reason: Keeps the link to Matthew 4:16 without copying its Greek-based wording ("座っている" for the Hebrew "walk" and "dwell").

decisions.choice: "край смертної тіні" (L), "край, темний, як смерть" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the wording Matthew 4:16 uses for this line in this translation ("у краю смертної тіні"), so the quotation can be seen; Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means, as the English does. This is 9:2 in many Bibles; the meaning decision gives the numbering.

source.text: הִרְבִּ֣יתָ הַגּ֔וֹי ל֖וֹ הִגְדַּ֣לְתָּ הַשִּׂמְחָ֑ה שָׂמְח֤וּ לְפָנֶ֨יךָ֙ כְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת בַּקָּצִ֔יר כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגִ֖ילוּ בְּחַלְּקָ֥ם שָׁלָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: You have multiplied the nation, to it you have made great the joy; they rejoice before you like [the] joy at the harvest, as [people] are glad when they divide plunder.

en.L: You have multiplied the nation; \q for it you have made the joy great. \q They rejoice before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} like the joy at harvest, \q as [people] are glad when they divide plunder.
en.B: You have made the nation grow and filled it with great joy. \q In {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence they are glad with the gladness of harvest time, \q the delight of those who share out the spoils of war.
en.R: You have made the nation large and given it great joy. \q They are happy as they stand before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, like farmers at harvest time, \q like soldiers dividing up what they took in battle.

es.L: Has multiplicado la nación; \q le has engrandecido la alegría. \q Se alegran delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} como la alegría en la cosecha, \q como se regocijan [los que] reparten el botín.
es.B: Has hecho crecer la nación y la has llenado de gran alegría. \q En {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia se alegran con la alegría del tiempo de la cosecha, \q con el gozo de los que se reparten el botín de guerra.
es.R: Has hecho grande la nación y le has dado mucha alegría. \q Están felices delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, como los campesinos en el tiempo de la cosecha, \q como los soldados que se reparten lo que ganaron en la batalla.

fr.L: Tu as multiplié la nation ; \q pour elle {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as rendu la joie grande. \q Ils se réjouissent devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} comme on se réjouit à la moisson, \q comme on est dans l’allégresse quand on partage le butin.
fr.B: Tu as fait grandir la nation et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as remplie d’une grande joie. \q En {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} présence, ils se réjouissent comme on se réjouit au temps de la moisson, \q comme exultent ceux qui se partagent les dépouilles de la guerre.
fr.R: Tu as rendu la nation nombreuse et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lui as donné une grande joie. \q Ils sont heureux devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, comme les paysans au moment de la moisson, \q comme les soldats qui se partagent ce qu’ils ont pris à la guerre.

sw.L: Umeliongeza taifa; \q kwa ajili yake umeifanya furaha kuwa kuu. \q Wanafurahi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kama furaha wakati wa mavuno, \q kama [watu] wanavyoshangilia wanapogawanya nyara.
sw.B: Umelikuza taifa na kulijaza furaha kuu. \q Mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} wanafurahi kwa furaha ya wakati wa mavuno, \q furaha ya wale wanaogawana nyara za vita.
sw.R: Umelifanya taifa kuwa kubwa na kulipa furaha kuu. \q Wanafurahi wakisimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kama wakulima wakati wa mavuno, \q kama askari wanaogawana walichoteka vitani.

vi.L: Ngài đã làm cho dân tộc gia tăng; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho niềm vui của nó lớn lao. \q Họ vui mừng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như niềm vui lúc mùa gặt, \q như [người ta] hớn hở khi chia của cướp.
vi.B: Ngài đã làm cho dân tộc này thêm đông và ban cho họ niềm vui lớn. \q Họ hân hoan trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như người ta vui mừng lúc mùa gặt, \q như niềm vui của những người chia chiến lợi phẩm.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm cho dân tộc này đông đúc và ban cho họ niềm vui lớn lao. \q Họ vui mừng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như nhà nông lúc mùa gặt, \q như binh lính chia nhau những gì lấy được trong trận chiến.

ko.L: 주님께서 이 민족을 많게 하셨고, \q 그들에게 기쁨을 크게 하셨습니다. \q 그들이 추수할 때의 기쁨같이 주님 앞에서 기뻐하고, \q [사람들이] 전리품을 나눌 때 즐거워하듯 즐거워합니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 이 민족을 번성하게 하시고 큰 기쁨으로 채우셨습니다. \q 그들이 주님 앞에서 기뻐하는 것이 추수 때의 기쁨 같고, \q 전리품을 나누는 사람들의 즐거움 같습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 이 민족을 크게 만드시고 큰 기쁨을 주셨습니다. \q 그들은 추수하는 농부들처럼 주님 앞에서 기뻐합니다. \q 싸움에서 얻은 것을 나누는 군인들처럼 즐거워합니다.

pt.L: Multiplicaste a nação; \q para ela fizeste grande a alegria. \q Alegram-se diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} como a alegria na colheita, \q como [as pessoas] se alegram quando repartem os despojos.
pt.B: Tu fizeste a nação crescer e a encheste de grande alegria. \q Na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} presença eles se alegram com a alegria do tempo da colheita, \q o prazer dos que repartem os despojos da guerra.
pt.R: Tu fizeste a nação ficar grande e lhe deste muita alegria. \q Eles estão felizes diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, como os agricultores no tempo da colheita, \q como os soldados quando dividem o que tomaram na batalha.

am.L: ሕዝቡን አበዛህ፤ \q ደስታውንም አገነንህለት፤ \q በመከር ጊዜ እንደሚደረግ ደስታ በፊትህ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ \q ምርኮ ሲካፈሉ [ሰዎች] ሐሤት እንደሚያደርጉ።
am.B: ሕዝቡን አሳደግህ፤ በታላቅ ደስታም ሞላኸው። \q በመከር ወራት እንደሚሆን ደስታ በፊትህ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ \q የጦር ምርኮ እንደሚካፈሉ ሰዎች ሐሤት ያደርጋሉ።
am.R: ሕዝቡን አበዛኸው፤ ታላቅ ደስታም ሰጠኸው። \q በመከር ጊዜ እንዳሉ ገበሬዎች በፊትህ ቆመው ደስ ይላቸዋል። \q በጦርነት የማረኩትን እንደሚከፋፈሉ ወታደሮች ደስ ይላቸዋል።

hi.L: तूने जाति को बढ़ाया है; \q उसके लिए तूने आनंद को बड़ा किया है। \q वे तेरे सामने ऐसे आनंदित होते हैं जैसे कटनी के समय का आनंद, \q जैसे लोग लूट बाँटते समय मगन होते हैं।
hi.B: तूने राष्ट्र को बढ़ाया है और उसे बड़े आनंद से भर दिया है। \q तेरी उपस्थिति में वे कटनी के समय जैसे आनंदित हैं, \q जैसे युद्ध की लूट बाँटनेवाले मगन होते हैं।
hi.R: तूने इस देश के लोगों को बहुत बढ़ाया है और उन्हें बड़ा आनंद दिया है। \q वे तेरे सामने ऐसे ख़ुश हैं जैसे किसान फ़सल काटते समय ख़ुश होते हैं, \q जैसे सैनिक युद्ध में जीता हुआ माल बाँटते समय ख़ुश होते हैं।

ru.L: Ты умножил народ; \q ему {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал великой радость. \q Они радуются перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}, как радуются в жатву, \q как [люди] ликуют, когда делят добычу.
ru.B: Ты дал народу вырасти и наполнил его великой радостью. \q Перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}} они веселятся, как веселятся во время жатвы, \q как ликуют те, кто делит военную добычу.
ru.R: Ты сделал этот народ многочисленным и дал ему великую радость. \q Они радуются, стоя перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}, как радуются земледельцы во время жатвы, \q как радуются воины, когда делят то, что взяли в бою.

ja.L: あなたはその国を増し加え、 \q その[国]のために喜びを大きくされた。 \q 彼らはあなたの前で喜ぶ、刈り入れの時の喜びのように、 \q 分捕り物を分けるときに人々が楽しむように。
ja.B: あなたはこの国を大きくし、大いなる喜びで満たされた。 \q 人々はあなたの前で、刈り入れの時のように喜び、 \q 戦いの分捕り物を分け合う者たちのように楽しむ。
ja.R: あなたはこの国を大きくし、大きな喜びを与えてくださった。 \q 人々はあなたの前で喜んでいる。まるで、取り入れの時の農夫たちのようだ。 \q 戦いで奪った物を分け合う兵士たちのようだ。

uk.L: Ти примножив народ; \q для нього {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} звеличив радість. \q Вони радіють перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}, як радіють у жнива, \q як [люди] веселяться, коли ділять здобич.
uk.B: Ти дав народові зрости і сповнив його великою радістю. \q Перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}} вони радіють радістю жнив, \q утіхою тих, хто ділить воєнну здобич.
uk.R: Ти зробив народ численним і дав йому велику радість. \q Вони радіють, стоячи перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}, як хлібороби під час жнив, \q як воїни, що ділять узяте в бою.

decisions.choice: for it (the reading the scribes marked): you have made its joy great
alternatives: you have multiplied the nation, you have not increased the joy
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has "not" (lo with an aleph), which would give "you have not made the joy great". The scribes' note in the margin tells readers to say "to it", which sounds the same. "To it" fits the verse, which is all about joy, and is followed here.

decisions.choice: harvest and plunder: the two great times of rejoicing
decisions.reason: Harvest festivals and dividing the spoil after a victory were the best-known times of celebration (Psalm 4:8; Judges 5:30). The two pictures prepare for verses 3-4: the oppressor is broken and the war is over.

decisions.choice: you: God, addressed directly
decisions.reason: The prophet turns to speak to God. The nation is the people in darkness of verse 1; "before you" is the language of worship at God's sanctuary (Deuteronomy 12:7).

decisions.choice: farmers ... soldiers
decisions.reason: Readable names who rejoices at harvest and who divides plunder.

decisions.choice: The prophet addresses God in the formal style (합쇼체) with "주님" in verses 2-4; verse 5 returns to proclamation in the plain style
decisions.reason: Words spoken to God are 합쇼체 (terms note). Verses 5-6 do not address God and announce the child to all who hear, so they take the plain style of the oracles.

decisions.choice: the prophet speaks to God with "አንተ" ("አበዛህ", "በፊትህ")
decisions.reason: As prayer throughout this translation; Literal follows the scribes' reading "for it" (m1).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Hindi marks no capital for God's pronouns: the prophet speaks to God with तू (तूने, तेरे), the form used only for God, and God in the third person takes honorific plural forms (वे, उनका). So the English deity_pronoun setting has no Hindi span in this chapter or the rest of the passage.

decisions.choice: जाति
decisions.reason: The nation here is Israel. Literal uses जाति for goy as the poetry note does; Balanced uses राष्ट्र and Readable "इस देश के लोग", avoiding जाति, which also means caste.

decisions.choice: The prophet turns to God (m3): "あなた" in the plain poetic voice, with light respect forms for God's acts (大きくされた, 満たされた; R 与えてくださった).
decisions.reason: Isaiah conventions: the prophet addressing God inside an oracle uses あなた, plain, with light respect forms.

source.text: כִּ֣י׀אֶת־עֹ֣ל סֻבֳּל֗וֹ וְאֵת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁכְמ֔וֹ שֵׁ֖בֶט הַנֹּגֵ֣שׂ בּ֑וֹ הַחִתֹּ֖תָ כְּי֥וֹם מִדְיָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: For the yoke of his burden and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of the [one] driving him, you have shattered as [on] the day of Midian.

en.L: For the yoke of his burden and the staff on his shoulder, \q the rod of the one driving him, \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have shattered as [on] the day of Midian.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have smashed the yoke that weighed them down, \q the pole pressing on their shoulders, the rod of the man who drove them, \q as on the day of Midian.
en.R: You have broken the heavy yoke they carried on their shoulders. \q You have smashed the stick of the cruel master who drove them at forced labor. \q You did it just as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did on the day Gideon defeated Midian.

es.L: Porque el yugo de su carga y la vara sobre su hombro, \q el bastón del que lo oprime, \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} los has quebrado como [en] el día de Madián.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho pedazos el yugo que los agobiaba, \q la vara que les pesaba sobre los hombros, el bastón del capataz que los obligaba a trabajar, \q como en el día de Madián.
es.R: Rompiste el yugo pesado que llevaban sobre los hombros. \q Destrozaste el palo del amo cruel que los obligaba a hacer trabajos forzados. \q Lo hiciste tal como lo hiciste el día en que Gedeón derrotó a Madián.

fr.L: Car le joug de son fardeau et le bâton sur son épaule, \q la verge de celui qui le pressait, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as brisés comme au jour de Madiân.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as brisé le joug qui les accablait, \q la barre posée sur leurs épaules, le bâton de celui qui les poussait au travail, \q comme au jour de Madiân.
fr.R: Tu as brisé le lourd joug qu’ils portaient sur les épaules. \q Tu as cassé le bâton du maître cruel qui les forçait à travailler. \q Tu l’as fait comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’avais fait le jour où Gédéon a vaincu Madiân.

sw.L: Kwa maana nira ya mzigo wake na fimbo ya bega lake, \q gongo la yule anayemsukuma, \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umezivunja kama [katika] siku ya Midiani.
sw.B: Kwa maana umeivunja nira iliyowalemea, \q mti uliowabana mabegani, fimbo ya mtu aliyewasukuma kazini, \q kama siku ile ya Midiani.
sw.R: Umeivunja nira nzito waliyoibeba mabegani mwao. \q Umeivunja fimbo ya bwana mkatili aliyewalazimisha kufanya kazi ngumu. \q Ulifanya hivyo kama ulivyofanya siku ile Gideoni alipowashinda Wamidiani.

vi.L: Vì cái ách đè nặng trên nó, cây đòn trên vai nó, \q cây roi của kẻ đốc thúc nó, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bẻ gãy như trong ngày Ma-đi-an.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đập tan cái ách đè nặng trên họ, \q cây đòn đè trên vai họ, cây roi của kẻ đốc công, \q như trong ngày Ma-đi-an.
vi.R: Ngài đã bẻ gãy cái ách nặng nề trên vai họ. \q Ngài đã đập tan cây roi của kẻ chủ độc ác bắt họ làm lao dịch. \q Ngài đã làm điều ấy như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm trong ngày Ghê-đê-ôn đánh bại Ma-đi-an.

ko.L: 그들이 진 짐의 멍에와 그들 어깨의 막대기, \q 그들을 부리는 자의 몽둥이를 \q 주님께서 미디안의 날처럼 꺾으셨기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 그들을 짓누르던 멍에와 \q 그들의 어깨를 누르던 막대기와 그들을 부리던 자의 몽둥이를 \q 미디안을 치시던 날처럼 부수셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 그들이 어깨에 메고 있던 무거운 멍에를 꺾으셨습니다. \q 강제로 일을 시키던 잔인한 주인의 막대기를 부수셨습니다. \q 기드온이 미디안을 물리친 날에 하셨던 것처럼 그렇게 하셨습니다.

pt.L: Porque o jugo da sua carga e a vara do seu ombro, \q o bastão do que o oprimia, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} os despedaçaste como [no] dia de Midiã.
pt.B: Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} despedaçaste o jugo que pesava sobre eles, \q a vara que lhes apertava os ombros, o bastão do homem que os oprimia, \q como no dia de Midiã.
pt.R: Tu quebraste o jugo pesado que eles carregavam nos ombros. \q Despedaçaste o bastão do feitor cruel que os obrigava a trabalhar à força. \q Fizeste isso como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste no dia em que Gideão derrotou Midiã.

am.L: የሸክሙን ቀንበር፣ የጫንቃውንም በትር፣ \q የአስገባሪውንም ዘንግ፣ \q እንደ ምድያም ቀን ሰብረሃልና።
am.B: የሚጫናቸውን ቀንበር፣ \q ጫንቃቸውን የሚጫነውን ምሰሶና የአስገባሪያቸውን ዘንግ ሰብረሃልና፤ \q በምድያም ቀን እንደ ሆነው።
am.R: በጫንቃቸው የተሸከሙትን ከባድ ቀንበር ሰብረሃል። \q በግዳጅ ሥራ ያሠራቸው የነበረውን የጨካኙን አለቃ በትር አድቅቀሃል። \q ጌዴዎን ምድያምን ድል ባደረገበት ቀን እንዳደረግኸው አደረግህ።

hi.L: क्योंकि उसके बोझ का जूआ, और उसके कंधे का डंडा, \q और उसे हाँकनेवाले की छड़ी, \q तूने मिद्यान के दिन के समान तोड़ डाली है।
hi.B: क्योंकि जो जूआ उन्हें दबाए हुए था, \q जो डंडा उनके कंधों पर पड़ता था, और उन्हें हाँकनेवाले की छड़ी, \q उन्हें तूने चकनाचूर कर दिया है, जैसे मिद्यान के दिन किया था।
hi.R: तूने उनके कंधों पर रखा भारी जूआ तोड़ डाला है। \q तूने उस निर्दयी मालिक की छड़ी तोड़ डाली है जो उनसे ज़बरदस्ती काम करवाता था। \q तूने यह वैसे ही किया जैसे उस दिन किया था जब गिदोन ने मिद्यानियों को हराया था।

ru.L: Ведь ярмо его бремени и палку на плече его, \q жезл того, кто гонит его, \q {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сокрушил, как в день Мадиама.
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} разбил ярмо, что давило их, \q жердь, что гнула им плечи, палку того, кто гнал их на работу, \q как в день Мадиама.
ru.R: Ты сломал тяжёлое ярмо, которое они несли на плечах. \q Ты разбил палку жестокого надсмотрщика, который гнал их на подневольную работу. \q Ты сделал это так же, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал в тот день, когда Гедеон разбил Мадиам.

ja.L: まことに、彼が負う重荷のくびき、彼の肩の棒、 \q 彼を追い使う者の杖を、 \q あなたはミディアンの日のように打ち砕かれた。
ja.B: あなたは、彼らを押しつぶしていたくびきと、 \q その肩を打つ棒、彼らを追い使う者のむちを、 \q ミディアンの日のように砕かれたからだ。
ja.R: あなたは、人々が肩にかついでいた重いくびきをこわしてくださった。 \q 彼らを無理やり働かせた、ひどい主人の棒を打ち砕いてくださった。 \q それは、ギデオンがミディアン人を打ち破った日に、あなたがしてくださったのと同じだ。

uk.L: Бо ярмо його тягаря, і палицю на його плечі, \q жезл того, хто його поганяє, \q {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} розбив, як у день Мідіяну.
uk.B: Бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} розтрощив ярмо, що гнітило їх, \q дрючок, що тиснув їм на плечі, палицю того, хто їх поганяв, \q як у день Мідіяну.
uk.R: Ти зламав важке ярмо, яке вони несли на плечах. \q Ти розтрощив палицю жорстокого пана, який гнав їх на примусову працю. \q Ти зробив це так само, як у той день, коли Гедеон розбив Мідіян.

decisions.choice: the day of Midian: Gideon's victory (Judges 7)
decisions.reason: God gave Gideon victory over Midian with three hundred men, so that Israel could not boast that its own strength had saved it (Judges 7:2, 22). Isaiah recalls the same day in 10:26, and Psalm 83:10 asks God to act again as he did against Midian.

decisions.choice: the one driving him: the taskmaster, the oppressor
decisions.reason: The word is used of the slave drivers of Egypt (Exodus 3:7; 5:6) and of oppressive rulers (3:12; 14:2, 4). Yoke, pole and rod are the gear of forced labor.

decisions.choice: his: the people, spoken of as one
decisions.reason: "His burden" and "his shoulder" refer to the nation of verse 2, spoken of as one person. The objects are put first for weight, and the verb comes last: "you have shattered".

decisions.choice: them, their
decisions.reason: The singular collective is plural at Balanced and Readable (m3).

decisions.choice: on the day Gideon defeated Midian
decisions.reason: Readable names the event (m1).

decisions.choice: "the day of Midian" "የምድያም ቀን"; taskmaster "አስገባሪ", as Exodus
decisions.reason: Gideon's victory over Midian (Judges 7, "ምድያም", "ጌዴዎን" on main), which Readable names as the English Readable does; the driver is the taskmaster of Egypt's forced labour.

decisions.choice: जब गिदोन ने मिद्यानियों को हराया था
decisions.reason: Readable names the event, as the English does; गिदोन and मिद्यान keep the forms of Judges 7.

decisions.choice: "в тот день, когда Гедеон разбил Мадиам"
decisions.reason: Readable names the event (m1), as the English Readable does; Gideon takes the form of Judges, "Гедеон".

decisions.choice: keyom midyan "ミディアンの日" (L, B); Readable names Gideon and the Midianites ("ギデオン", "ミディアン人"), as the English Readable and Judges 7.
decisions.reason: Names as Judges and Hebrews 11:32.

source.text: כִּ֤י כָל־סְאוֹן֙ סֹאֵ֣ן בְּרַ֔עַשׁ וְשִׂמְלָ֖ה מְגוֹלָלָ֣ה בְדָמִ֑ים וְהָיְתָ֥ה לִשְׂרֵפָ֖ה מַאֲכֹ֥לֶת אֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: For every boot tramping with quaking, and cloak rolled in bloods, and it will be for burning, fuel of fire.

en.L: For every boot that tramped with a din \q and every cloak rolled in blood \q will be for burning, fuel for fire.
en.B: For every boot that stamped and thundered in battle, \q every cloak caked in blood, \q will go to be burned, food for the fire.
en.R: All the boots of soldiers marching to war will be burned up. \q All their clothes covered in blood will be fuel for the fire.

es.L: Porque toda bota que pisaba con estruendo \q y todo manto revolcado en sangre \q serán para quemar, pasto del fuego.
es.B: Porque toda bota que pisoteaba con estrépito en la batalla \q y todo manto empapado en sangre \q serán quemados, alimento para el fuego.
es.R: Todas las botas de los soldados que marchaban a la guerra serán quemadas. \q Toda su ropa manchada de sangre servirá de leña para el fuego.

fr.L: Car toute botte qui piétinait avec fracas \q et tout manteau roulé dans le sang \q seront pour le feu, nourriture des flammes.
fr.B: Car toute botte qui martelait le sol au combat, \q tout manteau couvert de sang \q sera livré au feu, pâture des flammes.
fr.R: Toutes les bottes des soldats qui partaient à la guerre seront brûlées. \q Tous leurs vêtements couverts de sang serviront à nourrir le feu.

sw.L: Kwa maana kila kiatu kilichokanyaga kwa kishindo \q na kila vazi lililovingirishwa katika damu \q vitakuwa kwa kuchomwa, kuni za moto.
sw.B: Kwa maana kila kiatu kilichokanyaga na kutoa kishindo vitani, \q kila vazi lililoganda damu, \q vitapelekwa kuchomwa, viwe chakula cha moto.
sw.R: Viatu vyote vya askari waliokwenda vitani vitateketezwa. \q Mavazi yao yote yaliyojaa damu yatakuwa kuni za moto.

vi.L: Vì mọi chiếc giày ủng giẫm rầm rập \q và mọi áo choàng lăn trong máu \q sẽ bị đốt, làm mồi cho lửa.
vi.B: Vì mọi chiếc giày ủng giẫm rầm rập nơi chiến trận, \q mọi áo choàng đẫm máu, \q sẽ bị đem đốt, làm mồi cho lửa.
vi.R: Mọi đôi giày của binh lính hành quân ra trận sẽ bị thiêu hủy. \q Mọi quần áo dính đầy máu sẽ làm củi cho lửa.

ko.L: 요란하게 밟고 다니던 모든 군화와 \q 피에 뒹군 모든 겉옷이 \q 불살라져 불의 땔감이 될 것이기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 전쟁터에서 쿵쾅거리며 밟던 군화와 \q 피범벅이 된 겉옷이 모두 \q 불에 타서 불쏘시개가 될 것입니다.
ko.R: 전쟁에 나가던 군인들의 군화가 모두 불에 탈 것입니다. \q 피 묻은 그들의 옷도 모두 불의 땔감이 될 것입니다.

pt.L: Porque toda bota que marchava com estrondo \q e todo manto revolvido em sangue \q serão para queimar, combustível para o fogo.
pt.B: Pois toda bota que pisava com estrondo na batalha, \q todo manto empapado de sangue, \q irá para o fogo, para ser queimado.
pt.R: Todas as botas dos soldados que marcham para a guerra vão ser queimadas. \q Todas as suas roupas cheias de sangue vão ser lenha para o fogo.

am.L: በሁካታ የተረገጠ የጫማ ኮቴ ሁሉ፣ \q በደምም የተንከባለለ ልብስ ሁሉ፣ \q ለእሳት ማገዶ ሆኖ ይቃጠላልና።
am.B: በጦርነት እያስገመገመ የረገጠ የወታደር ጫማ ሁሉ፣ \q በደም የተለወሰ ልብስ ሁሉ፣ \q ይቃጠላልና፤ ለእሳትም ምግብ ይሆናል።
am.R: ወደ ጦርነት የሚዘምቱ ወታደሮች ጫማዎች ሁሉ ይቃጠላሉ። \q በደም የተሸፈኑ ልብሶቻቸውም ሁሉ ለእሳት ማገዶ ይሆናሉ።

hi.L: क्योंकि धमाके के साथ रौंदनेवाला हर एक जूता \q और लहू में लथपथ हर एक चोग़ा \q जलाया जाएगा, आग का ईंधन बनेगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि युद्ध में धमक के साथ चलनेवाला हर जूता, \q और लहू से सना हर चोग़ा, \q जलने के लिए होगा, आग का ईंधन बनेगा।
hi.R: युद्ध में जानेवाले सैनिकों के सारे जूते जला दिए जाएँगे। \q ख़ून से भीगे उनके सारे कपड़े आग में ईंधन बन जाएँगे।

ru.L: Ведь всякий сапог, топающий с грохотом, \q и плащ, вывалянный в крови, \q будут для сожжения, пищей огню.
ru.B: Ведь всякий сапог, что топал и гремел в бою, \q всякий плащ, пропитанный кровью, \q пойдёт в огонь, станет пищей для пламени.
ru.R: Все сапоги воинов, шагавших на войну, будут сожжены. \q Вся их одежда, залитая кровью, пойдёт на топливо для огня.

ja.L: まことに、地響きを立てて踏み鳴らすすべての兵の靴と、 \q 血にまみれた衣は、 \q 焼かれて、火の燃料となる。
ja.B: 戦場で地を踏み鳴らしたすべての兵士の靴も、 \q 血にまみれたすべての上着も、 \q 焼き払われ、火にくべられる。
ja.R: 戦いに向かって行進した兵士たちの靴は、みな焼かれてしまう。 \q 血だらけになった彼らの服も、みな燃やされて、火のたきぎになる。

uk.L: Бо кожен чобіт, що тупотів з гуркотом, \q і кожен плащ, вивалений у крові, \q будуть на спалення, поживою для вогню.
uk.B: Бо кожен чобіт, що тупотів і гримів у битві, \q кожен плащ, закипілий кровʼю, \q піде на спалення, на поживу вогню.
uk.R: Усі чоботи воїнів, що йшли на війну, згорять. \q Увесь їхній одяг, залитий кровʼю, стане паливом для вогню.

decisions.choice: boot ... tramping: a soldier's boot on the march
decisions.reason: The noun and the verb from it occur only here. A related word in other Semitic languages means a soldier's boot or sandal; with "shaking" or "din" it pictures an army marching.

decisions.choice: burning: the gear of war is destroyed because the war is over
decisions.reason: Burning the weapons and clothing of war means there will be no more battles. Psalm 46:10 says God makes wars cease and burns the chariots with fire, and 2:4 pictures swords beaten into plowshares.

decisions.choice: soldiers marching to war
decisions.reason: Readable says whose boots these are (m1).

source.text: כִּי־יֶ֣לֶד יֻלַּד־לָ֗נוּ בֵּ֚ן נִתַּן־לָ֔נוּ וַתְּהִ֥י הַמִּשְׂרָ֖ה עַל־שִׁכְמ֑וֹ וַיִּקְרָ֨א שְׁמ֜וֹ פֶּ֠לֶא יוֹעֵץ֙ אֵ֣ל גִּבּ֔וֹר אֲבִי עַ֖דשַׂר־שָׁלֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: For [a] child has been born to us, [a] son has been given to us, and has come to be the dominion on his shoulder, and [one] has called his name Wonder Counselor, God Mighty, Father of Perpetuity, Prince of Peace.

en.L: For a child has been born to us, a son has been given to us, \q and the rule has come to be on his shoulder; \q and [one] has called his name Wonder Counselor, Mighty God, \q Father of Eternity, Prince of Peace.
en.B: For a child has been born for us, a son has been given to us, \q and the right to rule rests on his shoulders. \q He has been named Planner of Wonders, God the Mighty Warrior, \q Father for All Time, Ruler of Peace.
en.R: A child has been born for us! A son has been given to us! \q He has been given the power to rule. \q He has been named Planner of Wonders, God the Mighty Warrior, Father Forever, and Ruler Who Brings Peace.

es.L: Porque un niño nos ha nacido, un hijo nos ha sido dado, \q y el dominio ha venido a estar sobre su hombro; \q y se ha llamado su nombre Consejero Maravilla, Dios Poderoso, \q Padre de Eternidad, Príncipe de Paz.
es.B: Porque nos ha nacido un niño, se nos ha dado un hijo, \q y el derecho a gobernar descansa sobre sus hombros. \q Ha sido llamado Autor de planes maravillosos, Dios Guerrero Poderoso, \q Padre para siempre, Gobernante de paz.
es.R: ¡Nos ha nacido un niño! ¡Se nos ha dado un hijo! \q Se le ha dado el poder para gobernar. \q Ha sido llamado Autor de planes maravillosos, Dios Guerrero Poderoso, Padre para siempre y Gobernante que trae la paz.

fr.L: Car un enfant nous est né, un fils nous a été donné, \q et la souveraineté est sur son épaule ; \q et on l’a appelé du nom de Merveille de conseiller, Dieu puissant, \q Père d’éternité, Prince de paix.
fr.B: Car un enfant est né pour nous, un fils nous a été donné, \q et le droit de régner repose sur ses épaules. \q On lui a donné pour nom Celui qui conçoit des merveilles, Dieu le Guerrier puissant, \q Père pour toujours, Chef de la paix.
fr.R: Un enfant est né pour nous ! Un fils nous a été donné ! \q Il a reçu le pouvoir de régner. \q On lui a donné pour nom Celui qui conçoit des merveilles, Dieu le Guerrier puissant, Père pour toujours et Chef qui apporte la paix.

sw.L: Kwa maana mtoto amezaliwa kwetu, mwana tumepewa, \q na utawala umekuwa juu ya bega lake; \q na [mtu] ameliita jina lake Mshauri-Ajabu, Mungu Shujaa, \q Baba wa Milele, Mkuu wa Amani.
sw.B: Kwa maana mtoto amezaliwa kwa ajili yetu, mtoto wa kiume tumepewa, \q na mamlaka ya kutawala yako mabegani mwake. \q Amepewa jina Mpangaji wa Maajabu, Mungu Shujaa Mwenye Nguvu, \q Baba wa Nyakati Zote, Mtawala wa Amani.
sw.R: Mtoto amezaliwa kwa ajili yetu! Tumepewa mtoto wa kiume! \q Amepewa mamlaka ya kutawala. \q Amepewa jina Mpangaji wa Maajabu, Mungu Shujaa Mwenye Nguvu, Baba wa Milele, na Mtawala Aletaye Amani.

vi.L: Vì một con trẻ đã sinh ra cho chúng ta, một con trai đã được ban cho chúng ta, \q quyền cai trị ở trên vai người; \q người ta gọi tên người là Đấng Cố Vấn Kỳ Diệu, Đức Chúa Trời Quyền Năng, \q Cha Đời Đời, Hoàng Tử Bình An.
vi.B: Vì một con trẻ đã sinh ra cho chúng ta, một con trai đã được ban cho chúng ta, \q và quyền cai trị đặt trên vai người. \q Người được gọi là Đấng Cố Vấn Kỳ Diệu, Đức Chúa Trời Quyền Năng, \q Cha Đời Đời, Hoàng Tử Bình An.
vi.R: Một con trẻ đã sinh ra cho chúng ta! Một con trai đã được ban cho chúng ta! \q Người đã được ban quyền cai trị. \q Người được gọi là Đấng Cố Vấn Kỳ Diệu, Đức Chúa Trời Quyền Năng, Người Cha Đời Đời, và Vua mang lại bình an.

ko.L: 한 아이가 우리에게 태어났고, 한 아들이 우리에게 주어졌기 때문이다. \q 그리고 다스림이 그의 어깨 위에 있게 되었다. \q 그리고 그의 이름은 놀라운 조언자, 용사이신 하나님, \q 영원의 아버지, 평화의 통치자라 불렸다.
ko.B: 우리를 위해 한 아이가 태어났고, 우리에게 한 아들이 주어졌다. \q 다스리는 권세가 그의 어깨 위에 있다. \q 그의 이름은 놀라운 일을 계획하는 이, 용사이신 하나님, \q 영원한 아버지, 평화의 통치자라 불린다.
ko.R: 우리를 위해 한 아기가 태어났다! 우리에게 한 아들이 주어졌다! \q 그는 다스릴 권세를 받았다. \q 그의 이름은 놀라운 계획을 세우는 이, 용사이신 하나님, 영원한 아버지, 평화를 가져오는 통치자라 불린다.

pt.L: Porque uma criança nasceu para nós, um filho foi dado a nós, \q e o governo veio a estar sobre o seu ombro; \q e [alguém] chamou o seu nome Conselheiro Maravilha, Deus Poderoso, \q Pai da Perpetuidade, Príncipe da Paz.
pt.B: Pois uma criança nasceu para nós, um filho foi dado a nós, \q e o direito de governar repousa sobre os seus ombros. \q Ele recebeu o nome de Conselheiro de Maravilhas, Deus, o Guerreiro Poderoso, \q Pai para Sempre, Governante da Paz.
pt.R: Uma criança nasceu para nós! Um filho foi dado a nós! \q Ele recebeu o poder de governar. \q Ele foi chamado de Conselheiro de Maravilhas, Deus, o Guerreiro Poderoso, Pai para Sempre e Governante que Traz a Paz.

am.L: ለእኛ ልጅ ተወልዶልናልና፤ ለእኛ ወንድ ልጅ ተሰጥቶናል፤ \q አገዛዝም በጫንቃው ላይ ሆኗል፤ \q ስሙንም፦ ድንቅ አማካሪ፣ ጀግና አምላክ፣ \q የዘላለም አባት፣ የሰላም መስፍን ብለው ጠሩት።
am.B: ልጅ ተወልዶልናልና፤ ወንድ ልጅ ለእኛ ተሰጥቶአል፤ \q የመግዛት መብትም በጫንቃው ላይ ያርፋል። \q ስሙም ድንቅ ነገሮችን የሚያቅድ፣ ኃያል ተዋጊ የሆነ አምላክ፣ \q የዘመናት ሁሉ አባት፣ የሰላም ገዢ ተብሎ ተጠርቷል።
am.R: ልጅ ተወልዶልናል! ወንድ ልጅ ተሰጥቶናል! \q የመግዛት ሥልጣን ተሰጥቶታል። \q ስሙም ድንቅ ነገሮችን የሚያቅድ፣ ኃያል ተዋጊ የሆነ አምላክ፣ ለዘላለም አባት፣ ሰላምን የሚያመጣ ገዢ ተብሎ ተጠርቷል።

hi.L: क्योंकि हमारे लिए एक बालक उत्पन्न हुआ है, हमें एक पुत्र दिया गया है, \q और प्रभुता उसके कंधे पर ठहरी है; \q और उसका नाम रखा गया है: अद्भुत परामर्शदाता, पराक्रमी परमेश्वर, \q अनन्तता का पिता, शान्ति का प्रधान।
hi.B: क्योंकि हमारे लिए एक बालक जन्मा है, हमें एक पुत्र दिया गया है, \q और राज करने का अधिकार उसके कंधों पर है। \q उसे ये नाम दिए गए हैं: अद्भुत योजनाएँ बनानेवाला, योद्धा पराक्रमी परमेश्वर, \q सदा के लिए पिता, शान्ति का शासक।
hi.R: हमारे लिए एक बालक जन्मा है! हमें एक पुत्र दिया गया है! \q उसे राज करने का अधिकार दिया गया है। \q उसे ये नाम दिए गए हैं: अद्भुत योजनाएँ बनानेवाला, योद्धा पराक्रमी परमेश्वर, सदा का पिता, और शान्ति लानेवाला शासक।

ru.L: Ведь ребёнок родился для нас, сын дан нам, \q и власть стала на плече его; \q и нарекли ему имя: Чудо-Советник, Бог Могучий, \q Отец Вечности, Князь Мира.
ru.B: Ведь ребёнок родился для нас, сын дан нам, \q и право править лежит на его плечах. \q Ему дали имя: Замышляющий чудеса, Бог — могучий Воин, \q Отец на все времена, Правитель, несущий мир.
ru.R: Ребёнок родился для нас! Сын дан нам! \q Ему дана власть править. \q Его назвали так: Замышляющий чудеса, Бог — могучий Воин, Отец навсегда и Правитель, который приносит мир.

ja.L: まことに、わたしたちのために一人の子が生まれ、わたしたちに一人の息子が与えられた。 \q 主権がその肩に置かれ、 \q その名は、驚くべき助言者、勇士である神、 \q とこしえの父、平和の君と呼ばれる。
ja.B: わたしたちのために、一人の子が生まれた。わたしたちに、男の子が授けられた。 \q 治める権威は、その肩にある。 \q その子は、驚くべき計画を立てる方、勇士である神、 \q 永遠に父である方、平和の君と名づけられた。
ja.R: わたしたちのために子どもが生まれた！わたしたちに男の子が与えられた！ \q その子は、国を治める力を与えられた。 \q その子は、驚くべき計画を立てる方、力強い戦士である神、いつまでも父である方、平和をもたらす王と名づけられた。

uk.L: Бо дитина народилася нам, син даний нам, \q і влада опинилася на його плечі; \q і назвали його імʼя: Чудо-Порадник, Бог Могутній, \q Батько Вічності, Володар Миру.
uk.B: Бо дитина народилася для нас, син даний нам, \q і право правити лежить на його плечах. \q Його назвали: Той, хто задумує дива, Бог — Могутній Воїн, \q Батько на всі часи, Правитель миру.
uk.R: Для нас народилася дитина! Нам даний син! \q Йому дано владу правити. \q Його назвали: Творець дивовижних задумів, Бог — Могутній Воїн, Батько навіки і Правитель, що приносить мир.

decisions.choice: for a child has been born: the third and greatest reason for the joy
decisions.reason: Verses 3, 4 and 5 each begin with "for" and give the reasons for the joy of verse 2: the oppressor broken, the war gear burned, and now a royal child. The verbs are in the form for completed action. A prophet can speak of what God will surely do as already done, or announce a birth that has just happened; the passage does not name the child. 7:14 promised a son called Immanuel, and 11:1-5 describes a king from the line of Jesse.

decisions.choice: the rule on his shoulder: he carries the authority of the king
decisions.reason: The word for rule or dominion occurs only here and in verse 6. Authority is pictured as something carried on the shoulder, as the key of David's house is laid on Eliakim's shoulder in 22:22. This is the opposite of the yoke on the people's shoulder in verse 3.

decisions.choice: one has called his name: he is given these names, the namer unstated
decisions.reason: The verb is active, "and he called", with no subject named. It may be impersonal ("his name is called"), which is how the Septuagint takes it, or God may be the one who gives the names. Either way, these are the names the child bears.

decisions.choice: four titles of the child, each made of two words
alternatives: one sentence-name about God: "The mighty God plans wonders; the eternal Father is a ruler of peace"
decisions.reason: Isaiah's own sons have names that are sentences about God's acts (Shear-jashub in 7:3; Maher-shalal-hash-baz in 8:3), and Immanuel means "God is with us" (7:14; 8:8). Read that way, these words could be one long name that speaks about God and not about the child: "a planner of wonders is the mighty God; the everlasting father is a prince of peace". But they stand after "his name" as four pairs, each a title, and verse 6 goes straight on to describe this king's rule on David's throne. They are taken here as titles of the child himself.

decisions.choice: Planner of Wonders: a counselor whose plans are wonders
decisions.reason: The first word is the noun "a wonder", used of the extraordinary acts only God does (Exodus 15:11; 25:1; 29:14). The second is "one who counsels, who plans", a role of kings (Micah 4:9). In 28:29 the same two roots describe the LORD of hosts, who makes his counsel wonderful. The title is more than "a good adviser": his plans are wonders.

decisions.choice: Mighty God: God the mighty warrior
decisions.reason: The first word is the common short word for God; the second means a mighty man, a warrior, a hero. In 10:21 the same two words name the God to whom the remnant of Jacob will return, and Deuteronomy 10:17 and Jeremiah 32:18 call God "the great, the mighty". The plural of the first word can mean "mighty ones", that is, chiefs (Ezekiel 32:21), so the pair could mean "mighty hero"; but in Isaiah the singular always means God or a god (31:3; 44:15). Read as a title of the child, it gives a king the name of God, as Psalm 45:7 addresses the king's throne as God's.

decisions.choice: Father Forever: one who is a father to his people for all time
decisions.reason: "Father" is used of a ruler who protects and provides for his people: Eliakim will be "a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem" (22:21). The second word means lasting time, perpetuity, as in "forever" in verse 6 and in 26:4; 57:15 says God inhabits it.

decisions.choice: Prince of Peace: a ruler whose reign brings peace
decisions.reason: The first word is used of princes, officials and commanders (1:23; 3:3; 32:1). Verse 6 explains the title: peace without end. Peace here is safety and well-being for the whole kingdom, after the war gear of verse 4 is burned.

decisions.choice: Planner of Wonders, God the Mighty Warrior, Father for All Time (Forever), Ruler of Peace (Who Brings Peace)
alternatives: Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the shortest form of each pair. Balanced and Readable say what each title means (m5-m8), instead of the familiar "Wonderful Counselor", "Everlasting Father" and "Prince of Peace".

decisions.choice: He has been named
decisions.reason: The active verb with no subject (m3) is put in the passive at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps "[one] has called".

decisions.choice: Consejero Maravilla, Dios Poderoso, Padre de Eternidad, Príncipe de Paz (L); Autor de planes maravillosos, Dios Guerrero Poderoso, Padre para siempre, Gobernante de paz (B, R)
alternatives: Admirable Consejero, Dios fuerte, Padre eterno, Príncipe de paz
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets it: L keeps the shortest form of each two-word title, and B and R say what each one means (meaning decisions m5-m8), as the English does, instead of the familiar wording of the Reina-Valera tradition. This is Hebrew 9:5, 9:6 in many Bibles.

decisions.choice: Ha sido llamado
decisions.reason: The active verb with no subject (meaning decision m3) is put in the passive at B and R, as the English does; L keeps the impersonal "se ha llamado su nombre".

decisions.choice: L "Mshauri-Ajabu, Mungu Shujaa, Baba wa Milele, Mkuu wa Amani"; B "Mpangaji wa Maajabu, Mungu Shujaa Mwenye Nguvu, Baba wa Nyakati Zote, Mtawala wa Amani"; R "... Baba wa Milele, Mtawala Aletaye Amani"
alternatives: "Mshauri, Mungu mwenye nguvu, Baba wa milele, Mfalme wa amani"
decisions.reason: The four two-word titles (m4-m8) follow the English levels, as the terms note settles; the wording keeps clear of the Union Version's four names. The child takes no deity span, as in English.

decisions.choice: "Merveille de conseiller, Dieu puissant, Père d’éternité, Prince de paix" (L); "Celui qui conçoit des merveilles, Dieu le Guerrier puissant, Père pour toujours, Chef de la paix" (B); R the same, "Chef qui apporte la paix"
alternatives: "Conseiller merveilleux, Dieu fort, Père éternel, Prince de la paix"
decisions.reason: The terms note’s titles: Literal keeps the two-word forms, Balanced and Readable say what each title means (meaning decisions m5-m8), avoiding the familiar French wording. No deity_pronoun span on the child, as in English.

decisions.choice: "On lui a donné pour nom"
decisions.reason: French uses the impersonal "on" for the verb with no stated subject (meaning decision m3), where English uses the passive.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Cố Vấn Kỳ Diệu, Đức Chúa Trời Quyền Năng, Cha Đời Đời, Hoàng Tử Bình An"; at R "Vua mang lại bình an"
alternatives: "Đấng Mưu Tính Những Điều Kỳ Diệu, Đức Chúa Trời Chiến Sĩ Quyền Năng" (closer to the English Balanced)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms, each a pair of words as in the Hebrew (meaning decision m4); they are drafted from the Hebrew and not from a published Vietnamese Bible. A reviewer should weigh them against the English Balanced's "Planner of Wonders" and "God the Mighty Warrior".

decisions.choice: the child is "người", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: As the terms note and the English record set: the king of 9:5 takes no span; Vietnamese uses the respectful "người" for him.

decisions.choice: L "놀라운 조언자, 용사이신 하나님, 영원의 아버지, 평화의 통치자"; B "놀라운 일을 계획하는 이, ..., 영원한 아버지, 평화의 통치자"; R "놀라운 계획을 세우는 이, ..., 평화를 가져오는 통치자"
alternatives: "기묘자, 모사, 전능하신 하나님, 영존하시는 아버지, 평강의 왕"
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms, which follow the English reading of four titles of two words each (meaning decisions m4-m8) rather than the familiar older wording.

decisions.choice: "그" and plain verbs, without "-시-", for the child
decisions.reason: The terms note: the child of 9:5 takes no honorific, as the English has no deity_pronoun span for him; "용사이신 하나님" keeps the honorific inside the title itself.

decisions.choice: Conselheiro Maravilha, Deus Poderoso, Pai da Perpetuidade, Príncipe da Paz (L); Conselheiro de Maravilhas, Deus, o Guerreiro Poderoso, Pai para Sempre, Governante da Paz (B); the same, with Governante que Traz a Paz (R)
alternatives: Maravilhoso Conselheiro, Deus Forte, Pai da Eternidade, Príncipe da Paz
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the four two-word titles (m4-m8). Literal keeps each pair in its shortest form, noun beside noun as in the Hebrew ("Conselheiro Maravilha", "Pai da Perpetuidade" for 'avi-'ad); Balanced and Readable say what each title means, as the English does, instead of the familiar wording, which turns "wonder" into an adjective. 10:21 uses the same "Deus Poderoso" (L) and "Deus, o Guerreiro Poderoso" (B). The child's pronouns take no deity_pronoun setting, as in the English.

decisions.choice: Ele recebeu o nome de (B); Ele foi chamado de (R)
decisions.reason: The active verb with no subject (m3) is turned into "recebeu o nome", as the English Balanced uses the passive; Literal keeps "[alguém] chamou".

decisions.choice: the four names: "ድንቅ አማካሪ፣ ጀግና አምላክ፣ የዘላለም አባት፣ የሰላም መስፍን" (L); "ድንቅ ነገሮችን የሚያቅድ፣ ኃያል ተዋጊ የሆነ አምላክ፣ የዘመናት ሁሉ አባት፣ የሰላም ገዢ" (B); Readable as Balanced, with "ለዘላለም አባት" and "ሰላምን የሚያመጣ ገዢ"
decisions.reason: Each name is two Hebrew words, and Literal keeps two Amharic words for each: "ጀግና" for gibbor, the warrior, and "መስፍን" (prince, noble) for sar. Balanced and Readable say what each title means, as the meaning decisions and the English do. The verse was drafted fresh from the Hebrew; the familiar wording of the 1962 Bible is not followed.

decisions.choice: "the rule has come to be on his shoulder" "አገዛዝም በጫንቃው ላይ ሆኗል" (L); "one has called his name" "ስሙንም ... ብለው ጠሩት" (L), "... ተብሎ ተጠርቷል" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's repeated "to us" and gives the unnamed namer as the Amharic impersonal plural ("ብለው ጠሩት"); Balanced and Readable use the passive, as the English does. "ጫንቃ" is the shoulder that bears a yoke, as in verse 3, where the burden was; now the rule rests there.

decisions.choice: अद्भुत परामर्शदाता, पराक्रमी परमेश्वर, अनन्तता का पिता, शान्ति का प्रधान
alternatives: the wording of the older Hindi versions
decisions.reason: Literal keeps each two-word title close to the Hebrew (wonder + counselor, God + mighty, father + perpetuity, prince + peace), drafted from the gloss and not from the familiar Hindi wording; प्रधान is the word for sar (prince, official).

decisions.choice: अद्भुत योजनाएँ बनानेवाला, योद्धा पराक्रमी परमेश्वर, सदा का पिता, शान्ति (लानेवाला) शासक
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable say what each title means: a counselor whose plans are wonders, God the mighty warrior, a father to his people for all time, a ruler whose reign brings peace.

decisions.choice: उसका नाम रखा गया है; उसे ये नाम दिए गए हैं
alternatives: किसी ने उसका नाम रखा है
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "one has called his name" names no one; Hindi uses the passive at every level, which is the ordinary way to say this.

decisions.choice: "Чудо-Советник, Бог Могучий, Отец Вечности, Князь Мира" (L); "Замышляющий чудеса, Бог — могучий Воин, Отец на все времена (навсегда), Правитель, несущий (который приносит) мир" (B, R)
alternatives: "Чудный, Советник, Бог крепкий, Отец вечности, Князь мира" (the Synodal)
decisions.reason: Drafted from the gloss. Literal keeps each title as two words, as the Hebrew does (m4); Balanced and Readable say what each title means (m5-m8), as the English does. "Князь Мира" is kept only at Literal: at the other levels "мир" could be read as "the world", so the ruler is one who brings peace. The child takes no deity_pronoun span, as in English.

decisions.choice: "нарекли ему имя" (L), "Ему дали имя" (B), "Его назвали" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb has no stated subject (m3). Russian gives the unnamed namer as the impersonal plural at Literal, which needs no brackets, and with a passive-like turn at Balanced and Readable, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The four names, each of two Hebrew words (m4): pele' yo'ets "驚くべき助言者" (L), "驚くべき計画を立てる方" (B, R); 'el gibbor "勇士である神" (L, B), "力強い戦士である神" (R); 'avi'ad "とこしえの父" (L), "永遠に父である方" (B), "いつまでも父である方" (R); sar shalom "平和の君" (L, B), "平和をもたらす王" (R). No quotation marks, as the English.
decisions.reason: Drafted from the Hebrew and the meaning decisions (m5-m8), following the English levels: Literal keeps the two-word titles, Balanced and Readable say what each means. "平和の君" is the conventional title for sar shalom in Japanese and is kept at L and B as a short common phrase; 'el gibbor "勇士である神" (gibbor is the warrior, m6) is used again for the same words in 10:21.

decisions.choice: The child is referred to as "その子" or by "その肩" / "その名", never "彼", at every level; the coming king of 9:5-6 and 11:1-5 takes no pronoun where Japanese can leave it out, and plain verbs (respect forms stay for God).
decisions.reason: Japanese can leave the subject out; "彼" would sound flat for the promised king, and respect forms would decide for the reader who the child is.

decisions.choice: The four names: "Чудо-Порадник, Бог Могутній, Батько Вічності, Володар Миру" (L); "Той, хто задумує дива, Бог — Могутній Воїн, Батько на всі часи, Правитель миру" (B); "Творець дивовижних задумів, Бог — Могутній Воїн, Батько навіки і Правитель, що приносить мир" (R)

source.text: לְמַרְבֵּ֨ההַמִּשְׂרָ֜ה וּלְשָׁל֣וֹם אֵֽין־קֵ֗ץ עַל־כִּסֵּ֤א דָוִד֙ וְעַל־מַמְלַכְתּ֔וֹ לְהָכִ֤ין אֹתָהּ֙ וּֽלְסַעֲדָ֔הּ בְּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּבִצְדָקָ֑ה מֵעַתָּה֙ וְעַד־עוֹלָ֔ם קִנְאַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה־זֹּֽאת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Of [the] increase of the dominion and of peace [there is] no end, on [the] throne of David and over his kingdom, to establish it and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from now and until forever. [The] zeal of Yahweh of hosts will do this.

en.L: Of the increase of the rule and of peace there [will be] no end, on the throne of David and over his kingdom, \q to establish it and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness \q from now and until forever. \q The zeal of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts will do this.
en.B: His rule will grow and grow, and its peace will never end, on David's throne and over his kingdom, \q as he makes it firm and holds it up with justice and righteousness \q from now on and for all time. \q The burning zeal of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies will make this happen.
en.R: His power to rule will keep growing, and there will be peace without end. \q He will rule as king on David's throne and over David's kingdom. \q He will make the kingdom strong and keep it standing by doing what is fair and right, from now on and forever. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies has set {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} heart on doing this, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will do it.

es.L: Del aumento del dominio y de la paz no [habrá] fin, sobre el trono de David y sobre su reino, \q para establecerlo y sostenerlo con derecho y con justicia \q desde ahora y para siempre. \q El celo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos hará esto.
es.B: Su dominio crecerá sin cesar, y su paz no tendrá fin, sobre el trono de David y sobre su reino, \q pues él lo afirmará y lo sostendrá con derecho y justicia \q desde ahora y para siempre. \q El celo ardiente {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos hará que esto suceda.
es.R: Su poder para gobernar seguirá creciendo, y habrá paz sin fin. \q Reinará como rey en el trono de David y sobre el reino de David. \q Hará fuerte el reino y lo mantendrá en pie haciendo lo que es justo y recto, desde ahora y para siempre. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos se ha propuesto de todo corazón hacer esto, y lo hará.

fr.L: À l’accroissement de la souveraineté et à la paix [il n’y aura] pas de fin, sur le trône de David et sur son royaume, \q pour l’affermir et le soutenir par le droit et par la justice, \q dès maintenant et pour toujours. \q Le zèle {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées fera cela.
fr.B: Son pouvoir ne cessera de grandir, et sa paix n’aura pas de fin, sur le trône de David et sur son royaume, \q car il l’affermira et le soutiendra par le droit et la justice, \q dès maintenant et pour toujours. \q L’amour ardent {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées accomplira cela.
fr.R: Son pouvoir de roi ne cessera de grandir, et la paix n’aura pas de fin. \q Il régnera comme roi sur le trône de David et sur le royaume de David. \q Il rendra le royaume solide et le maintiendra debout en faisant ce qui est juste et droit, dès maintenant et pour toujours. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées a décidé de tout son cœur de faire cela, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le fera.

sw.L: Kuongezeka kwa utawala na kwa amani [hakutakuwa na] mwisho, juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Daudi na juu ya ufalme wake, \q kuuimarisha na kuutegemeza kwa hukumu na kwa haki \q tangu sasa na hata milele. \q Wivu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi utafanya hili.
sw.B: Utawala wake utaendelea kukua, na amani yake haitakuwa na mwisho, juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Daudi na juu ya ufalme wake, \q anapouimarisha na kuutegemeza kwa haki na uadilifu \q tangu sasa na hata nyakati zote. \q Wivu mkali wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi utalitimiza jambo hili.
sw.R: Mamlaka yake ya kutawala yataendelea kukua, na kutakuwa na amani isiyo na mwisho. \q Atatawala kama mfalme katika kiti cha enzi cha Daudi na juu ya ufalme wa Daudi. \q Ataufanya ufalme kuwa imara na kuudumisha kwa kutenda yaliyo haki na sawa, tangu sasa na hata milele. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ameweka moyo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kufanya hivi, naye atalitimiza.

vi.L: Quyền cai trị và sự bình an gia tăng không bao giờ cùng, trên ngai Đa-vít và trên vương quốc người, \q để lập nó vững và nâng đỡ nó bằng công lý và sự công chính, \q từ nay cho đến đời đời. \q Lòng nhiệt thành của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ làm điều này.
vi.B: Quyền cai trị của người sẽ lớn mãi, và sự bình an sẽ không bao giờ dứt, trên ngai Đa-vít và trên vương quốc người, \q khi người lập vững và nâng đỡ vương quốc bằng công lý và sự công chính \q từ nay cho đến đời đời. \q Lòng nhiệt thành nóng cháy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ thực hiện điều này.
vi.R: Quyền cai trị của người sẽ không ngừng gia tăng, và sự bình an sẽ không bao giờ dứt. \q Người sẽ làm vua trên ngai Đa-vít và cai trị vương quốc của Đa-vít. \q Người sẽ làm cho vương quốc vững mạnh và đứng vững bằng cách làm điều công bằng và công chính, từ nay cho đến mãi mãi. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã quyết lòng làm điều này, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm.

ko.L: 그 다스림의 더함과 평화가 끝이 없을 것이니, 다윗의 왕좌 위에서, 그리고 그의 나라 위에서 \q 그것을 굳게 세우고 정의와 의로 붙들 것이다. \q 지금부터 영원까지이다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 열심이 이것을 이룰 것이다.
ko.B: 그의 다스림은 점점 커지고, 그 평화는 끝이 없을 것이다. 그는 다윗의 왕좌에 앉아 그 나라를 다스리며, \q 정의와 의로 그 나라를 굳게 세우고 떠받칠 것이다. \q 지금부터 영원토록 그렇게 할 것이다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 불타는 열심이 이 일을 이룰 것이다.
ko.R: 그가 다스리는 힘은 점점 커질 것이고, 평화가 끝없이 이어질 것이다. \q 그는 다윗의 왕좌에 앉아 다윗의 나라를 다스릴 것이다. \q 그는 공정하고 바른 일을 하여 그 나라를 튼튼하게 세우고 지켜 나갈 것이다. 지금부터 영원히 그렇게 할 것이다. \q 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 일을 이루시기로 마음을 정하셨으니, 그분께서 반드시 이루실 것이다.

pt.L: Do aumento do governo e da paz não [haverá] fim, sobre o trono de Davi e sobre o seu reino, \q para firmá-lo e sustentá-lo com justiça e com retidão \q desde agora e para sempre. \q O zelo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos fará isto.
pt.B: O seu governo vai crescer sem parar, e a sua paz nunca terá fim, sobre o trono de Davi e sobre o seu reino, \q enquanto ele o firma e o sustenta com justiça e retidão \q desde agora e para sempre. \q O zelo ardente {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos fará isso acontecer.
pt.R: O seu poder de governar vai continuar crescendo, e haverá paz sem fim. \q Ele vai reinar como rei no trono de Davi e sobre o reino de Davi. \q Ele vai deixar o reino forte e vai mantê-lo de pé fazendo o que é justo e certo, de agora em diante e para sempre. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos quer fazer isso de todo o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} coração, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai cumprir.

am.L: የአገዛዙ እድገትና ሰላሙ መጨረሻ አይኖራቸውም፤ በዳዊት ዙፋንና በመንግሥቱ ላይ [ይሆናል]፤ \q በፍርድና በጽድቅ ያጸናውና ይደግፈው ዘንድ፣ \q ከአሁን ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም። \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ጸባኦት ቅንዓት ይህን ያደርጋል።
am.B: አገዛዙ እየሰፋ ይሄዳል፤ ሰላሙም ፍጻሜ የለውም፤ በዳዊት ዙፋንና በመንግሥቱ ላይ ይሆናል፤ \q በፍትሕና በጽድቅ ያጸናዋል፤ ደግፎም ያቆመዋል፤ \q ከአሁን ጀምሮ ለዘመናት ሁሉ። \q የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} የሚነድ ቅንዓት ይህን ይፈጽማል።
am.R: የመግዛት ሥልጣኑ እያደገ ይሄዳል፤ ሰላምም ያለ መጨረሻ ይሆናል። \q በዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ ንጉሥ ሆኖ፣ በዳዊትም መንግሥት ላይ ይገዛል። \q ትክክልና ፍትሐዊ የሆነውን በማድረግ መንግሥቱን ያጠነክረዋል፤ እንዳይወድቅም ያደርገዋል፤ ከአሁን ጀምሮ ለዘላለም። \q የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህን ለማድረግ ልቡን አጽንቷል፤ ይፈጽመዋልም።

hi.L: प्रभुता की बढ़ती और शान्ति का कोई अंत न [होगा], दाऊद के सिंहासन पर और उसके राज्य पर, \q कि वह उसे स्थिर करे और न्याय और धार्मिकता से उसे सँभाले रहे, \q अब से लेकर सदा तक। \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की लगन यह करेगी।
hi.B: उसकी प्रभुता बढ़ती ही जाएगी, और उसकी शान्ति का कभी अंत न होगा, दाऊद के सिंहासन पर और उसके राज्य पर, \q जब वह न्याय और धार्मिकता से उसे दृढ़ करेगा और थामे रहेगा, \q अब से लेकर सदा तक। \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की धधकती लगन यह पूरा करके रहेगी।
hi.R: उसका राज करने का अधिकार बढ़ता ही जाएगा, और ऐसी शान्ति होगी जिसका कोई अंत नहीं। \q वह दाऊद के सिंहासन पर बैठकर दाऊद के राज्य पर राजा के रूप में राज करेगा। \q वह जो ठीक और सही है वही करके राज्य को मज़बूत करेगा और उसे स्थिर रखेगा, अब से हमेशा तक। \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह करने की ठान ली है, और वे इसे करेंगे।

ru.L: Умножению власти и миру нет конца на престоле Давида и над царством его, \q чтобы утвердить его и поддержать его правосудием и праведностью \q отныне и до века. \q Ревность {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа совершит это.
ru.B: Его власть будет расти и расти, и мир её не кончится — на престоле Давида и над его царством, \q когда он утвердит его и укрепит правосудием и праведностью \q отныне и навсегда. \q Пламенная ревность {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа совершит это.
ru.R: Его власть будет всё расти, и мир будет без конца. \q Он будет править как царь на престоле Давида и над царством Давида. \q Он сделает царство крепким и будет поддерживать его, поступая справедливо и праведно, отныне и навсегда. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств всем сердцем решил сделать это, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} это сделает.

ja.L: その主権の増し加わることと平和とには、終わりがない。ダビデの王座の上に、またその王国の上に。 \q それを確立し、それを支える、公正と正義によって、 \q 今から、とこしえまで。 \q 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の熱心がこれを行う。
ja.B: その主権はますます広がり、その平和は終わることがない。ダビデの王座に着いてその王国を治め、 \q 公正と正義によって、それを固く立て、支える。 \q 今から後、とこしえまで。 \q 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の燃える熱心が、これを実現させる。
ja.R: その子の治める力は大きくなり続け、平和は終わることがない。 \q その子は、ダビデの王座に着いて、ダビデの国を治める。 \q 公平で正しいことを行って、その国を強くし、いつまでも支える。今からとこしえまで、そうする。 \q 天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、これを行おうと心に決めておられる。そして、その方はそれを成し遂げられる。

uk.L: Зростанню влади і миру не [буде] кінця на престолі Давида і над його царством, \q щоб утвердити його і підтримувати правосуддям і праведністю \q відтепер і навіки. \q Ревність {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} Саваота зробить це.
uk.B: Його влада зростатиме і зростатиме, і його мирові не буде кінця, на престолі Давида і над його царством, \q бо він утвердить його і підтримуватиме правосуддям і праведністю \q відтепер і на всі часи. \q Палка ревність {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} Небесних Військ здійснить це.
uk.R: Його влада правити зростатиме, і настане мир, якому не буде кінця. \q Він царюватиме на престолі Давида і над царством Давида. \q Він зміцнить царство і триматиме його, чинячи справедливо і правильно, відтепер і навіки. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель поклав собі на серце зробити це, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} це зробить.

decisions.choice: of the increase: one word, as the scribes read it
alternatives: to them, great will be the rule
decisions.reason: In the Leningrad Codex the word for "increase" is written with the closed form of the letter mem that belongs at the end of a word, as if it were two words ("to them" and "great"). The scribes' note reads it as one word with the ordinary letter, and the sense "of the increase" fits the verse. The odd letter is a well-known peculiarity of this verse.

decisions.choice: the throne of David and his kingdom: the promise to David
decisions.reason: God promised David a son whose throne and kingdom he would establish forever (2 Samuel 7:12-16; Psalm 89:4-5, 30). The same verb "establish" is used there. Luke 1:32-33 echoes this verse: the throne of David and a kingdom with no end.

decisions.choice: zeal: God's burning commitment
decisions.reason: The word means intense, passionate devotion; when someone or something rivals what is God's own it is "jealousy" (Exodus 20:5). Here it is God's determination to keep his promise. The same sentence closes the promise of a remnant in 37:32.

decisions.choice: justice and righteousness: rule that is fair and right
decisions.reason: The pair describes what God looked for in Israel and did not find (5:7) and the king of 11:4-5 and 32:1.

decisions.choice: has set his heart on doing this
decisions.reason: Readable explains "zeal" (m3).

decisions.choice: "wivu" for God's zeal
decisions.reason: "Wivu" is God's jealous, burning commitment to his people (m3); "bidii" would be mere diligence. Readable says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "정의와 의" (L, B); "공정하고 바른 일" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's pair for *mishpat* and *tsedaqah*.

decisions.choice: zeal (qinʾah) "ቅንዓት" (L), "የሚነድ ቅንዓት" (B); justice and righteousness "ፍርድና ጽድቅ" (L), "ፍትሕና ጽድቅ" (B)
decisions.reason: "ቅንዓት" is the word of the jealous God of the Law ("የሚቀና አምላክ"), his burning commitment to his people. The verse (9:7 in most English Bibles) was drafted fresh from the Hebrew; the familiar 1962 wording of "no end" ("ፍጻሜ የለውም") is kept only at Balanced, as a short common phrase.

decisions.choice: लगन; धधकती लगन
decisions.reason: qin'ah here is God's burning commitment (m3), not envy; जलन would suggest jealousy. Readable explains it as God having set his heart on it (ठान ली है), as the English does.

decisions.choice: the last line as 2 Kings 19:31: "Ревность ГОСПОДА Саваофа совершит это" (L), "Пламенная ревность ..." (B), "ГОСПОДЬ Воинств всем сердцем решил сделать это, и он это сделает" (R)
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew sentence ends 2 Kings 19:31 (Isaiah 37:32), already drafted; the Russian copies its wording at each level.

decisions.choice: qin'at YHWH "{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の熱心" (L), "燃える熱心" (B); Readable "心に決めておられる" as the English Readable.
decisions.reason: "熱心" is God's burning commitment (m3) without the jealousy sense "ねたみ" would add here.

records.literal_gloss: [A] word has sent [the] Lord against Jacob, and it has fallen on Israel.

en.L: A word the Lord has sent against Jacob, \q and it has fallen on Israel.
en.B: The Lord has sent out a word against Jacob, \q and it has come down on Israel.
en.R: The Lord has sent a message against the people of Jacob. \q It has come down on the kingdom of Israel.

es.L: Una palabra envió el Señor contra Jacob, \q y ha caído sobre Israel.
es.B: El Señor ha enviado una palabra contra Jacob, \q y ha caído sobre Israel.
es.R: El Señor ha enviado un mensaje contra el pueblo de Jacob. \q Ha caído sobre el reino de Israel.

fr.L: Une parole, le Seigneur l’a envoyée contre Jacob, \q et elle est tombée sur Israël.
fr.B: Le Seigneur a envoyé une parole contre Jacob, \q et elle s’est abattue sur Israël.
fr.R: Le Seigneur a envoyé un message contre le peuple de Jacob. \q Il s’est abattu sur le royaume d’Israël.

sw.L: Neno Bwana amelituma juu ya Yakobo, \q nalo limeanguka juu ya Israeli.
sw.B: Bwana ametuma neno dhidi ya Yakobo, \q nalo limeshuka juu ya Israeli.
sw.R: Bwana ametuma ujumbe dhidi ya watu wa Yakobo. \q Umeshuka juu ya ufalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Chúa đã sai một lời nghịch cùng Gia-cốp, \q và lời ấy đã giáng xuống trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Chúa đã phán một lời nghịch lại Gia-cốp, \q và lời ấy đã giáng xuống Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Chúa đã gửi một sứ điệp nghịch lại dân Gia-cốp. \q Sứ điệp ấy đã giáng xuống vương quốc Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 주님께서 야곱에게 말씀을 보내셨고, \q 그것이 이스라엘 위에 떨어졌다.
ko.B: 주님께서 야곱을 치시려고 말씀을 보내셨고, \q 그 말씀이 이스라엘에 내려졌다.
ko.R: 주님께서 야곱 백성을 치시는 말씀을 보내셨다. \q 그 말씀이 이스라엘 나라에 떨어졌다.

pt.L: Uma palavra o Senhor enviou contra Jacó, \q e ela caiu sobre Israel.
pt.B: O Senhor enviou uma palavra contra Jacó, \q e ela desceu sobre Israel.
pt.R: O Senhor mandou uma mensagem contra o povo de Jacó. \q Ela caiu sobre o reino de Israel.

am.L: ጌታ በያዕቆብ ላይ ቃልን ላከ፤ \q በእስራኤልም ላይ ወደቀ።
am.B: ጌታ በያዕቆብ ላይ ቃል ልኳል፤ \q በእስራኤልም ላይ ወርዷል።
am.R: ጌታ በያዕቆብ ዘሮች ላይ መልእክት ልኳል። \q መልእክቱም በእስራኤል መንግሥት ላይ ወርዷል።

hi.L: प्रभु ने याकूब के विरुद्ध एक वचन भेजा है, \q और वह इस्राएल पर आ पड़ा है।
hi.B: प्रभु ने याकूब के विरुद्ध एक वचन भेजा है, \q और वह इस्राएल पर उतर आया है।
hi.R: प्रभु ने याकूब के वंशजों के विरुद्ध एक संदेश भेजा है। \q वह इस्राएल के राज्य पर आ पड़ा है।

ru.L: Слово послал Господь против Иакова, \q и оно пало на Израиль.
ru.B: Господь послал слово против Иакова, \q и оно обрушилось на Израиль.
ru.R: Господь послал весть против народа Иакова. \q Она обрушилась на царство Израиль.

ja.L: 一つの言葉を、主はヤコブに対して送られた。 \q それはイスラエルの上に落ちた。
ja.B: 主はヤコブに向けて言葉を放たれた。 \q それはイスラエルの上に下った。
ja.R: 主は、ヤコブの子孫に向けて言葉を送られた。 \q その言葉は、イスラエル王国の上に下った。

uk.L: Слово послав Господь на Якова, \q і воно впало на Ізраїль.
uk.B: Господь послав слово на Якова, \q і воно зійшло на Ізраїль.
uk.R: Господь послав звістку проти народу Якова. \q Вона впала на царство Ізраїль.

decisions.choice: a word ... has fallen: God's spoken judgment, sent like a weapon
decisions.reason: God's word is not only a message but a power that does what it says (55:10-11). It is "sent" and "falls" like a blow. This begins a poem in four stanzas, each ending with the same refrain (9:11, 16, 20; 10:4).

decisions.choice: Jacob, Israel: the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: Verse 8 names Ephraim and Samaria, the northern kingdom and its capital. Jacob and Israel here are the ten northern tribes, not Judah.

decisions.choice: the people of Jacob, the kingdom of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear the names stand for a people and a kingdom (m2).

decisions.choice: "the Lord" (Adonai) "ጌታ"; the oracle of 9:7-10:4 against the northern kingdom, with the refrain of 5:25
decisions.reason: The refrain at 9:11, 16, 20 keeps the Amharic set in 5:25 at each level.

source.text: וְיָדְעוּ֙ הָעָ֣ם כֻּלּ֔וֹ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב שֹׁמְר֑וֹן בְּגַאֲוָ֛ה וּבְגֹ֥דֶל לֵבָ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And will know the people, all of it, Ephraim and [the] inhabitant of Samaria, in pride and in greatness of heart, saying,

en.L: And the people will know, all of them, \q Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, \q who say in pride and in greatness of heart,
en.B: Every one of them will find it out, \q Ephraim and everyone living in Samaria, \q the people who boast with proud, swollen hearts,
en.R: All the people of Ephraim and of the city of Samaria will learn what it means. \q They are proud and think they are great. They say,

es.L: Y lo sabrá el pueblo, todo él, \q Efraín y el habitante de Samaria, \q que dicen con soberbia y con altivez de corazón:
es.B: Todos ellos lo sabrán, \q Efraín y todos los que viven en Samaria, \q la gente que presume con corazón orgulloso e hinchado:
es.R: Toda la gente de Efraín y de la ciudad de Samaria aprenderá lo que significa. \q Son orgullosos y se creen grandes. Dicen:

fr.L: Et le peuple le saura, tout entier, \q Éphraïm et l’habitant de Samarie, \q qui disent dans [leur] orgueil et dans la grandeur de [leur] cœur :
fr.B: Tous sans exception l’apprendront, \q Éphraïm et tous ceux qui habitent Samarie, \q eux qui se vantent, le cœur gonflé d’orgueil :
fr.R: Tout le peuple d’Éphraïm et de la ville de Samarie comprendra ce que cela veut dire. \q Ils sont orgueilleux et se croient grands. Ils disent :

sw.L: Na watu watajua, wote, \q Efraimu na mkaaji wa Samaria, \q wanaosema kwa kiburi na kwa ukuu wa moyo,
sw.B: Kila mmoja wao atalijua, \q Efraimu na kila aishiye Samaria, \q watu wanaojivuna kwa mioyo ya kiburi iliyojaa majivuno,
sw.R: Watu wote wa Efraimu na wa mji wa Samaria watajifunza maana yake. \q Wana kiburi na kujiona kuwa wakuu. Wanasema,

vi.L: Cả dân sẽ biết, \q Ép-ra-im và cư dân Sa-ma-ri, \q là những kẻ nói với lòng kiêu ngạo và tự cao rằng:
vi.B: Cả dân sẽ biết điều đó, \q Ép-ra-im và mọi người sống tại Sa-ma-ri, \q những kẻ khoác lác với lòng kiêu căng ngạo mạn:
vi.R: Mọi người dân Ép-ra-im và thành Sa-ma-ri sẽ hiểu điều ấy có nghĩa gì. \q Họ kiêu ngạo và cho mình là lớn. Họ nói:

ko.L: 그리고 백성이 모두 알게 될 것이다. \q 에브라임과 사마리아의 주민이 [알게 될 것이다]. \q 그들은 교만하고 마음이 높아져서 말한다.
ko.B: 백성이 모두 그것을 깨닫게 될 것이다. \q 에브라임과 사마리아에 사는 사람들이 다 알게 될 것이다. \q 그들은 교만하고 거만한 마음으로 큰소리친다.
ko.R: 에브라임과 사마리아 성의 모든 백성이 그 뜻을 알게 될 것이다. \q 그들은 교만하고 자기들이 대단하다고 생각한다. 그들은 말한다.

pt.L: E o povo saberá, todo ele, \q Efraim e o morador de Samaria, \q que dizem com orgulho e com grandeza de coração:
pt.B: Todos eles vão descobrir, \q Efraim e todos os que moram em Samaria, \q o povo que se vangloria com o coração orgulhoso e inchado:
pt.R: Todo o povo de Efraim e da cidade de Samaria vai aprender o que isso quer dizer. \q Eles são orgulhosos e se acham grandes. Eles dizem:

am.L: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ፣ \q ኤፍሬምና በሰማርያ የሚኖረው ያውቃሉ፤ \q በትዕቢትና በልብ ኩራት እንዲህ የሚሉ፦
am.B: ሁሉም ያውቁታል፤ \q ኤፍሬምና በሰማርያ የሚኖር ሁሉ፣ \q በትዕቢትና በተነፋ ልብ እንዲህ እያሉ የሚመኩ፦
am.R: የኤፍሬምና የሰማርያ ከተማ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ትርጉሙን ይማራሉ። \q ትዕቢተኞች ናቸው፤ ታላቅ እንደ ሆኑም ያስባሉ። እንዲህም ይላሉ፦

hi.L: और सब लोग जान लेंगे, \q एप्रैम और सामरिया का निवासी, \q जो घमंड और मन की बड़ाई से कहते हैं,
hi.B: उनमें से हर एक यह जान लेगा, \q एप्रैम और सामरिया में रहनेवाला हर कोई, \q वे लोग जो फूले हुए घमंडी मन से डींग मारते हैं,
hi.R: एप्रैम के और सामरिया नगर के सब लोग इसका अर्थ समझ जाएँगे। \q वे घमंडी हैं और अपने आप को बड़ा समझते हैं। वे कहते हैं,

ru.L: И узнает народ, весь он, \q Ефрем и житель Самарии, \q говорящие в гордости и в надменности сердца:
ru.B: Все до одного узнают это, \q Ефрем и всякий живущий в Самарии, \q те, кто хвалится с гордым, надменным сердцем:
ru.R: Весь народ Ефрема и жители города Самарии узнают, что это значит. \q Они горды и думают, что они велики. Они говорят:

ja.L: 民はみな、それを知る。 \q エフライムとサマリアの住民は。 \q 高ぶりと思い上がった心で、こう言う者たちは。
ja.B: 民は一人残らず、それを思い知る。 \q エフライムも、サマリアに住む者たちも皆。 \q 高慢で思い上がった心で、こう誇る者たちは。
ja.R: エフライムとサマリアの町の人々は皆、それがどういうことかを思い知る。 \q 彼らは高慢で、自分たちは偉いと思っている。そして、こう言う。

uk.L: І пізнає народ, увесь він, \q Єфрем і мешканець Самарії, \q що кажуть у гордості і в пихатості серця:
uk.B: Усі до одного це пізнають, \q Єфрем і кожен, хто живе в Самарії, \q люди, що хизуються з гордим, надутим серцем:
uk.R: Усі люди Єфрема і міста Самарії дізнаються, що це означає. \q Вони горді й думають, що вони великі. Вони кажуть:

decisions.choice: Ephraim and Samaria: the northern kingdom and its capital
decisions.reason: Ephraim was the leading tribe of the north, and its name stands for the whole kingdom (7:2, 5, 8-9). Samaria was its capital city, built by Omri (1 Kings 16:24).

decisions.choice: will know: will learn by experience
decisions.reason: To know here is to feel the force of God's word, to find out what it means by what happens to them.

decisions.choice: greatness of heart: arrogance
decisions.reason: A big or swollen heart is pride. The same phrase is used of the king of Assyria in 10:12.

source.text: לְבֵנִ֥ים נָפָ֖לוּ וְגָזִ֣ית נִבְנֶ֑ה שִׁקְמִ֣ים גֻּדָּ֔עוּ וַאֲרָזִ֖ים נַחֲלִֽיף׃

records.literal_gloss: Bricks have fallen, and [with] hewn [stone] we will build; sycamores have been cut down, and cedars we will put in place.

en.L: "Bricks have fallen, but [with] dressed stone we will build; \q sycamores have been cut down, \q but cedars we will put in [their] place."
en.B: "Brick has tumbled down, but we will build in cut stone; \q sycamore wood has been chopped down, \q but cedar will take its place."
en.R: "Our brick walls have fallen, but we will build again with fine cut stone. \q The common sycamore trees have been cut down, but we will use costly cedar in their place."

es.L: «Los ladrillos han caído, pero con piedra labrada edificaremos; \q los sicómoros han sido cortados, \q pero cedros pondremos en [su] lugar».
es.B: «Los ladrillos se han venido abajo, pero construiremos con piedra tallada; \q la madera de sicómoro ha sido talada, \q pero el cedro ocupará su lugar».
es.R: «Nuestras paredes de ladrillo se han caído, pero volveremos a construir con fina piedra tallada. \q Los sicómoros comunes han sido cortados, pero en su lugar usaremos cedro costoso».

fr.L: « Les briques sont tombées, mais [en] pierres de taille nous bâtirons ; \q les sycomores ont été abattus, \q mais des cèdres nous mettrons [à leur] place. »
fr.B: « La brique s’est écroulée, mais nous bâtirons en pierres de taille ; \q le bois de sycomore a été abattu, \q mais le cèdre le remplacera. »
fr.R: « Nos murs de briques sont tombés, mais nous reconstruirons avec de belles pierres taillées. \q Les sycomores ordinaires ont été coupés, mais nous mettrons à leur place du cèdre, qui coûte cher. »

sw.L: "Matofali yameanguka, lakini [kwa] mawe yaliyochongwa tutajenga; \q mikuyu imekatwa, \q lakini mierezi tutaiweka [mahali pake]."
sw.B: "Matofali yamebomoka, lakini tutajenga kwa mawe yaliyochongwa; \q miti ya mikuyu imekatwa, \q lakini mierezi itachukua mahali pake."
sw.R: "Kuta zetu za matofali zimeanguka, lakini tutajenga tena kwa mawe mazuri yaliyochongwa. \q Mikuyu ya kawaida imekatwa, lakini tutatumia mierezi ya bei ghali mahali pake."

vi.L: "Gạch đã đổ, nhưng chúng ta sẽ xây [bằng] đá đẽo; \q cây sung đã bị đốn, \q nhưng chúng ta sẽ thay [vào] bằng cây bá hương."
vi.B: "Gạch đã sụp đổ, nhưng chúng ta sẽ xây lại bằng đá đẽo; \q gỗ sung đã bị đốn, \q nhưng gỗ bá hương sẽ thay vào."
vi.R: "Tường gạch của chúng ta đã đổ, nhưng chúng ta sẽ xây lại bằng đá đẽo đẹp. \q Những cây sung tầm thường đã bị đốn, nhưng chúng ta sẽ dùng gỗ bá hương quý giá thay vào."

ko.L: "벽돌이 무너졌으나 다듬은 돌로 우리가 지을 것이다. \q 뽕나무가 베어졌으나 \q 백향목으로 우리가 [그것을] 대신할 것이다."
ko.B: "벽돌이 무너졌으니 다듬은 돌로 다시 짓자. \q 뽕나무가 찍혀 넘어졌으니 \q 백향목으로 바꾸자."
ko.R: "우리의 벽돌 벽은 무너졌지만, 우리는 좋은 다듬은 돌로 다시 지을 것이다. \q 흔한 뽕나무는 베어졌지만, 그 대신 값비싼 백향목을 쓸 것이다."

pt.L: "Os tijolos caíram, mas [com] pedra lavrada construiremos; \q os sicômoros foram cortados, \q mas cedros poremos [no seu] lugar."
pt.B: "Os tijolos desabaram, mas construiremos com pedra lavrada; \q a madeira de sicômoro foi derrubada, \q mas o cedro tomará o seu lugar."
pt.R: "Os nossos muros de tijolo caíram, mas vamos construir de novo com pedra lavrada de qualidade. \q Os sicômoros comuns foram cortados, mas vamos usar o cedro, que é caro, no lugar deles."

am.L: «ጡቦች ወድቀዋል፤ በተጠረበ ድንጋይ ግን እንሠራለን፤ \q ሾላዎች ተቆርጠዋል፤ \q በስፍራቸው ግን ዝግባዎችን እንተካለን።»
am.B: «ጡብ ፈርሷል፤ እኛ ግን በተጠረበ ድንጋይ እንሠራለን፤ \q የሾላ እንጨት ተቆርጧል፤ \q በስፍራው ግን ዝግባ ይተካል።»
am.R: «የጡብ ቅጥሮቻችን ወድቀዋል፤ እኛ ግን በሚያምር የተጠረበ ድንጋይ እንደ ገና እንሠራለን። \q ተራዎቹ የሾላ ዛፎች ተቆርጠዋል፤ እኛ ግን በስፍራቸው ውድ የሆነውን ዝግባ እንጠቀማለን።»

hi.L: "ईंटें गिर गई हैं, पर हम गढ़े हुए पत्थरों से बनाएँगे; \q गूलर के पेड़ काट डाले गए हैं, \q पर हम [उनकी] जगह देवदार लगाएँगे।"
hi.B: "ईंटों की दीवार ढह गई है, पर हम तराशे हुए पत्थर से बनाएँगे; \q गूलर की लकड़ी काट डाली गई है, \q पर उसकी जगह देवदार लगेगा।"
hi.R: "हमारी ईंटों की दीवारें गिर गई हैं, पर हम फिर से बढ़िया तराशे हुए पत्थरों से बनाएँगे। \q गूलर के मामूली पेड़ काट डाले गए हैं, पर उनकी जगह हम क़ीमती देवदार लगाएँगे।"

ru.L: «Кирпичи упали, но [из] тёсаного [камня] мы построим; \q сикоморы срублены, \q но кедры мы поставим [на их] место.»
ru.B: «Кирпич обрушился, но мы построим из тёсаного камня; \q сикоморы срублены, \q но на их место встанет кедр.»
ru.R: «Наши кирпичные стены упали, но мы снова построим их из хорошего тёсаного камня. \q Простые сикоморы срублены, но мы поставим на их место дорогой кедр.»

ja.L: 「れんがは崩れた。だが、切り石で[わたしたちは]建てよう。 \q いちじく桑の木は切り倒された。 \q だが、杉の木を[その]代わりにしよう。」
ja.B: 「れんがは崩れ落ちたが、切り石で建て直そう。 \q いちじく桑は切り倒されたが、 \q 杉を代わりに使おう。」
ja.R: 「れんがの壁は崩れたが、高価な切り石で建て直そう。 \q 安いいちじく桑の木は切り倒されたが、その代わりに高価な杉の木を使おう。」

uk.L: «Цегла впала, але [з] тесаного каменю ми збудуємо; \q сикоморі зрубані, \q але кедри ми поставимо [на їхнє] місце.»
uk.B: «Цегла обвалилася, але ми збудуємо з тесаного каменю; \q сикоморове дерево зрубали, \q але кедр стане на його місце.»
uk.R: «Наші цегляні стіни впали, але ми знову збудуємо їх із гарного тесаного каменю. \q Прості сикомори зрубали, але ми поставимо на їхнє місце дорогі кедри.»

decisions.choice: brick and sycamore, cut stone and cedar: cheap materials and costly ones
